# SD18 deterministic Human Barbarian level 12 widening fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD18 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Barbarian
# level-1..level-11 martial chassis baseline
# (tests/sd18_barbarian_level11_greater_rage.rs) to level 12 as chosen
# input only. It names selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or
# parity values. It preserves the accepted Human race-choice seam
# (ability-bonus and bonus-feat) and the deterministic
# ability/feat/skill/equipment posture from the level-1 through level-11
# fixtures, adding only the level bump this bounded tranche needs, plus one
# new rage-power choice-slot line: 12th level IS a rage-power level (powers
# land at 2/4/6/8/10/12 per "she gains another rage power for every two
# levels of barbarian attained after 2nd level"), so the sixth numbered
# slot's own choice line is present, honoring the no-repeat-power clause
# against the five powers already selected at levels 2/4/6/8/10.
#
# It deliberately avoids every later Barbarian burden surface: no rage
# execution (activation, round tracking, fatigue), no rage-power EFFECT
# recognition or execution beyond the bounded numbered-slot idiom, no
# damage-reduction application engine, and no level-13+ progression. The
# PF1 Core Rulebook Barbarian class table's level-12 "Special" column reads
# "Rage power, trap sense +4" (verified independently against d20pfsrd and
# the Archives of Nethys aonprd.com mirror): the Trap Sense entry is a
# tier-rise on the already-grounded Trap Sense flat-magnitude formula
# pillar (barbarian level / 3), and the rage-power entry is the same
# open-ended choice-list feature already deliberately left
# named-but-unproven-in-effect at levels 2/4/6/8/10 — so no new pillar is
# grounded beyond the numbered-slot recognition idiom already proven five
# times over.
